LESSON: WRITING 2.3.1 SOCIAL WRITING - EMAIL

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do you normally communicate with your friends?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify components of emails for effective communication
2. compose and send an email message for self- expression

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 2.3.1 SOCIAL WRITING - EMAIL
This lesson teaches Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email for Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify components of emails for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. compose and send an email message for self- expression
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email above.
2. Explain Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 2.3.1 Social Writing - Email important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you normally communicate with your friends?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify components of emails for effective communication
2. compose and send an email message for self- expression

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
